definitions.gloss: lacking common sense; outrageous; beyond what is considered normal
definitions.explanation: Describes behavior, actions, or ideas that deviate from what society considers reasonable or normal. Almost always used critically.

examples.japanese: それは{常識外|じょうしきはず}れだ。
{常識外|じょうしきはず}れな{行動|こうどう}に{周囲|しゅうい}が{呆|あき}れた。
examples.english: Everyone around was appalled by the outrageous behavior.

examples.japanese: {深夜|しんや}に{大音量|だいおんりょう}で{音楽|おんがく}をかけるのは{常識外|じょうしきはず}れも{甚|はなは}だしい。
examples.english: Playing music at full volume in the middle of the night is an outrageous lack of common sense.

notes:
USAGE:
{常識外|じょうしきはず}れ is a compound of {常識|じょうしき} (common sense) and {外|はず}れ (deviation, miss). It is used critically to describe actions or people who violate social norms.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Used both as a noun and as a na-adjective modifier:
- {常識外|じょうしきはず}れだ (That's outrageous — predicative)
- {常識外|じょうしきはず}れな{行動|こうどう} (outrageous behavior — attributive)
- {常識外|じょうしきはず}れの{人|ひと} (a person who lacks common sense — の-modification)

RELATED WORDS:
- {非常識|ひじょうしき} (lacking common sense — similar meaning, more common)
- {型破|かたやぶ}り (unconventional — can be positive)
- {常軌|じょうき}を{逸|いっ}する (to deviate from the norm — formal)
